up: Retrieve activity rows for target CHEMBL1764946 (Chromobox protein homolog 7). Return the first 1000 rows matching the following criteria: standard_type is 'IC50', pchembl_value is not null, and standard_relation is '='. For each row, return the assay ChEMBL ID (assays.chembl_id), target type (target_dictionary.target_type), tax_id (target_dictionary.tax_id), canonical SMILES (compound_structures.canonical_smiles), molecule ChEMBL ID (molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), standard type (activities.standard_type), and pChEMBL value (activities.pchembl_value). Order the results by molecule ChEMBL ID and then by assay ChEMBL ID.
sql:
SELECT
  a.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id,
  td.target_type,
  td.tax_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  act.standard_type,
  act.pchembl_value
FROM activities act
JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON a.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON act.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE
  td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1764946'
  AND act.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND act.standard_relation = '='
  AND act.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY md.chembl_id, a.chembl_id
LIMIT 1000;
